# statusdrift_status_page_sections (Data Source)

Fetches all sections for a status page.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_id` (Number) The ID of the status page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `status_page_sections` (Attributes List) List of status page sections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_page_sections))

<a id="nestedatt--status_page_sections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_page_sections`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the section is enabled.
- `expanded` (Boolean) Whether the section is expanded by default.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the section.
- `name` (String) The name of the section.
- `position` (Number) The display position.
